# Source: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max: # Adapted for wisp-design: schema condensed to 6 columns; web stacks only.
# Style: dark-mode-noir — true dark ground (not pure black)
column3: single warm accent
column4: AA-throughout.

column3: prompt
column4: css_template
column5: checklist

column3: Primary button — warm accent on noir ground, AA-verified
column4: padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--dn-accent); color: var(--dn-ground); border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 200ms;
column5: ☐ AA contrast on accent fg ☐ ground NOT pure black ☐ visible focus ring (offset) ☐ 44x44 touch min

column3: Secondary — outlined on noir, fg-elevated text
column4: padding: 12px 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--dn-fg); border: 1px solid var(--dn-border); border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 500;
column5: ☐ AA contrast fg/ground ☐ border visible enough (not too faint) ☐ hover lifts border to accent

column3: Page ground — true dark (NOT pure black), warm undertone
column4: background: var(--dn-ground); color: var(--dn-fg);
column5: ☐ ground L≥0.10 (not pure black) ☐ warm undertone (slight hue) ☐ AA contrast for body

column3: Elevated surface — lighter L via tint, not white-on-top
column4: background: var(--dn-surface-1); border: 1px solid var(--dn-border); border-radius: 8px;
column5: ☐ elevation via lighter L (not white overlay) ☐ visible border for definition

column3: Feature card — elevated surface, restrained padding
column4: padding: 24px; background: var(--dn-surface-1); border: 1px solid var(--dn-border); border-radius: 8px;
column5: ☐ AA contrast text ☐ no soft chromatic shadow ☐ border visible enough

column3: Top nav — noir ground, hairline divider, accent on hover
column4: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 32px; background: var(--dn-ground); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dn-border);
column5: ☐ semantic <nav> ☐ skip-link ☐ aria-current ☐ AA contrast

column3: Display headline — bright fg, restrained tracking
column4: font-family: var(--dn-sans); font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--dn-fg);
column5: ☐ AA contrast (high — fg L≥0.92) ☐ line-height tight ☐ no chromatic gradient on text

column3: Body — slightly muted fg for less glare
column4: font-family: var(--dn-sans); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 65ch; color: var(--dn-fg-body);
column5: ☐ AA contrast (body L≥0.85) ☐ max 65ch ☐ less glare than pure-white

column3: Text input — surface ground, focus accent border
column4: padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--dn-surface-1); color: var(--dn-fg); border: 1px solid var(--dn-border); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 16px;
column5: ☐ font-size ≥16px iOS ☐ focus shifts border to accent ☐ AA contrast text ☐ visible label

column3: Input focus state — accent border + glow-free
column4: border-color: var(--dn-accent); outline: 2px solid var(--dn-accent); outline-offset: 1px;
column5: ☐ no soft chromatic glow ☐ visible focus ring ☐ AA contrast on accent

column3: Data table — hairline rules, tabular-nums, no zebra
column4: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--dn-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 14px; color: var(--dn-fg-body);
column5: ☐ tabular-nums ☐ hairline rules between rows ☐ AA contrast ☐ no chromatic zebra

column3: Status badge — semantic colour passes AA on noir
column4: display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--dn-surface-1); color: var(--dn-success); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid var(--dn-success);
column5: ☐ semantic colour + icon + text ☐ AA contrast colour-on-surface ☐ border for definition

column3: Modal — elevated surface, overlay
column4: position: fixed; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; background: oklch(8% 0 0 / 0.65);
column5: ☐ focus-trap ☐ ESC closes ☐ inert background ☐ overlay darker than ground

column3: Modal card — surface, hairline border
column4: padding: 32px; background: var(--dn-surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--dn-border); border-radius: 12px; max-width: 520px;
column5: ☐ AA contrast all text ☐ visible border ☐ no soft shadow needed (border carries)

column3: Section divider — visible hairline
column4: height: 1px; background: var(--dn-border); margin-block: 48px;
column5: ☐ semantic <hr> ☐ visible enough to read ☐ aria-hidden if decorative

column3: Focus ring — accent outline, offset for visibility
column4: outline: 2px solid var(--dn-accent); outline-offset: 2px;
column5: ☐ visible on all interactive ☐ AA contrast outline-on-ground ☐ offset for visibility

column3: Feature icon — stroke-only, fg-muted
column4: width: 24px; height: 24px; stroke: var(--dn-fg-muted); fill: none;
column5: ☐ stroke not fill ☐ aria-hidden if decorative ☐ AA contrast

column3: Empty state — muted fg, accent CTA
column4: display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 64px 24px; text-align: center; color: var(--dn-fg-muted);
column5: ☐ specific copy ☐ accent CTA passes AA ☐ no Lorem

column3: Footer — noir ground, hairline rule top
column4: padding-block: 64px; background: var(--dn-ground); border-top: 1px solid var(--dn-border);
column5: ☐ semantic <footer> ☐ AA contrast ☐ multi-column responsive

column3: Vertical list — sibling-gap, fg-body
column4: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; color: var(--dn-fg-body);
column5: ☐ semantic <ul>/<li> ☐ AA contrast ☐ adequate spacing
